title: Demystifying Objectivity with Operator Algebra Quantum Error Correction
summary: Quantum Darwinism extends the decoherence formalism to explain how objectivity emerges from quantum mechanics. However, existing approaches often capture only partial aspects of objectivity. By connecting quantum Darwinism to operator algebra quantum error correction, we show that the emergence of objectivity can be identified with the algebraic local recoverability of quantum codes.
